text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...One, two... one, two...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...It's no good. I still can't see a path 
to victory...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Um... I just can't feel confident that 
I'll be able to put on a performance that 
will satisfy everyone...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Once the excitement of a Winning Live 
passes a certain threshold, it becomes 
heavily reliant on individual charm.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
There were no established strategies, nor 
any clear patterns—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: I wonder what I should do...
choice_data_list:
Still, it seems there's plenty we can 
learn from the past.
Why not just make it your own way?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: And by that, you mean...?
choice_data_list:
Like, using someone you aspire to be as a 
reference or something.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
In that case... it might be presumptuous 
of me, but I'd like to look to Grass 
Wonder-san, who won three Grand Prix races 
in a row, for inspiration.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Her supple dance is like blooming 
flowers... Her live performance has the 
elegance of a refined Yamato Nadeshiko—
choice_data_list:
Let's go ask them directly for some tips, 
then.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
“—I see. Since I have some free time 
anyway, I don't mind at all.”

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: R-Really...!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Still... being praised so unconditionally 
is a little embarrassing, I must admit.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Still... those are my true feelings. 
Every time I watch Grass-san's live 
performances, the spirit of wabi-sabi just 
resonates through me, so to speak..."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. For the sake of our dear juniors, I 
must be sure to fulfill my role as an 
instructor properly.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Then let's head to the studio. First, the 
foundation—the basics of traditional 
Japanese dance—

Afterward—under Grass Wonder's strict yet 
gentle guidance, Chrono Genesis's dancing 
steadily improved.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: In my own way...?
choice_data_list:
You love the drama that's born in a race, 
don't you?

You love the drama that's born in a race, 
don't you?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Yes...
choice_data_list:
Maybe incorporate what you felt there into 
the dance?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...What I felt during the race.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Hah... next is, like this...!
choice_data_list: Amazing! That was even better than before!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe. It's all thanks to your advice, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...After that, I tried looking back on 
the mock race we ran before."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
“The burning desire not to lose in a 
dogfight, the sheer joy of claiming the 
spotlight—”

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
If the emotions born on that day can be 
expressed through dance, then that too 
becomes a thrilling drama...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Once I realized that, all that's left is 
to pursue that expression..."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I tried guiding the gaze, adjusting the 
size and speed of the swings while weaving 
in facial expressions... aiming to link 
them seamlessly with emotion.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Every race unfolds differently, but... if 
we anticipate more scenarios and keep 
building upon them, I'm sure—
choice_data_list:
You'll be able to convey any feeling at 
all!

You'll be able to express any feeling, 
won't you!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes...! Even at the live concert... I'll 
put on a thrilling drama for everyone...!

With her doubts cleared away, Chrono 
Genesis threw herself lively into dance 
practice.
